name: Crystal Boy
original_name: クリスタル ボーイ
source: Crystal Boy is a humanoid cyborg with a golden skeleton and a body made from indestructible, polarizing glass. Crystal Boy's signature weapon is a claw which he can attach to his right hand.
translation: Crystal Boy is a humanoid cyborg with a golden skeleton and a body made from indestructible, polarizing glass. Crystal Boy's signature weapon is a claw which he can attach to his right hand.
